dims_mm.note: Official size: 264.5*105.5*21.5mm; 36.1mm at the grips (AYANEO 2 vs GEEK comparison table)

slots.note: M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0; vendor says double-sided drives up to 8TB fit

ports.note: Fully functional USB 4.0 Type-C; charging and DP 1.4 4K60 output
Type-C, data transfer only; speed not stated
TF card slot, up to 300 MB/s

screen.note: No-bezel full display, 323 PPI, 400 nits, anti-fingerprint coated glass. AYANEO calls it LCD; panel type IPS from Wikipedia

controls.note: Master controller. Dual gyroscopes (body and controller). Hall linear triggers, 7.5 mm travel. Custom buttons LC, RC, and =

cooling: Custom fan cooler; vendor states up to 32-35 W heat dissipation
notes: Only SoC option is the Ryzen 7 6800U. Retail start price $1,099 (16GB/512GB); Super Early Bird $949 on Indiegogo. Indiegogo campaign ended 2023-01-03. Release date is the December 2022 shipping start given by Wikipedia (citing Liliputing). The spec table also lists AYANEO OS, which did not ship as an OS option.
